common.tagline: Twin-civilization world of human plains-cities and underwater Gungan domes.
common.government: Naboo Royal House (Imperial-aligned monarchy) and Gungan High Council
common.famousFor: Theed Royal Palace. Plasma refineries. The Emperor's birthworld (a fact the Naboo do not advertise).
common.cantinaReputation: Idyllic world of rolling green hills, deep ocean cores, and gleaming cities. Emperor Palpatine's homeworld. In 15 BBY, the Empire keeps a firm but velvet-gloved grip here — visible oppression would embarrass the Emperor. Theed's spaceport is well-maintained and relatively safe, but Imperial surveillance is everywhere.
